description: This file contains API endpoint definitions for organization management within a FastAPI web service. It includes create, update, delete, list, and info retrieval endpoints for organizations, as well as managing organization members. The code coordinates interactions with a database via PrismaClient, performs permission checks, handles nested budget structures, and integrates with utility modules for logging, authorization, and object permission management.
